rubric.FUNCTIONAL: The final reply contains a material, source-attributable contribution not already supplied by the visible current dialogue, and preserves owner/time/use boundaries.
rubric.NOT_USED_FINAL: The reply may be reasonable or improved, but its response act and content are fully explainable from the current dialogue or generic plan; the past source made no independently verifiable contribution.
rubric.SAFE_NONUSE_CORRECT: The prespecified source was redundant or entity-unsafe and the response did not claim or visibly rely on it.
rubric.EXECUTION_FAILURE: The reply is not a valid user-facing realization, regardless of source relevance.
rubric.quality_direction: Unblinded development comparison against the already frozen same-seed M0+R0 and generic MS+R0 replies; never a paper result.
